Preserve every column, UV island, dark gap, existing paint stripe and lamp at its exact normalized coordinate. Blue-charcoal/grey steel, restrained wear, crisp original structural seams and small fasteners; do not replace stars with dogs or add red branding. No new panels or lights.

No render, camera perspective, border, bloom, cast shadows, watermark, labels, text, added structural elements or redesign. Lamps are coloured glass without spill over metal.
